import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0075 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0075 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a + b ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
  have h3 : a + b ≤ (b + c) + (a + c) := by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm b c, add_comm a c]
    exact h1.trans (h2.add h1)
  have h4 : (b + c) + (a + c) ≤ 2 * c + 2 := by
    rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm c c, add_right_comm (b + c)]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  exact h3.le h4
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0075 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0075 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
